description: An oil painting of a rural mail carrier in a cap leaning from a horse-drawn wagon lettered 'U.S. MAIL' to put a letter in a roadside wooden mailbox with a red flag. A farmhouse and barn sit beside a dirt road under a moody sky. The scene fills the frame with no border. The only text is the lettering on the wagon, with a faint illegible mark above it.
reason: The wagon side has painted letters reading 'U.S. MAIL' plus a faint extra word above it. Repaint the wagon side blank, with no lettering.
